// diagnostic

E2913

A reactive {kind} can't hold a {type}.

What

A reactive {kind} can't hold a {type}.

Why

Signals and derived values hold ordinary data so it can be copied to dependents (D-REACT1=B). A function value isn't reactive data — wrap behaviour in an effect instead.

Fix

use a data value (number, text, list, struct, …); put behaviour in `reactive.effect`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2913: tests/ui/reactive_signal_of_function.stderr.

    |                          ^^^^^^
